messages:
elena: Quick update — ~18 SMB onboarders are blocked at 'ingest review' due to duplicate-doc detection failing in the batch job. Not a full outage but prevents readiness. I'm standing up an ops bridge at 10:30am PT (link below). Need: 1) short customer status note 2) 1-page exec summary for AMs 3) outreach plan + credit/enablement offer. @tom please draft the customer note, @maria_cs compile affected tenant list, @sarah_eng can you confirm root cause?

tom: On it. I'll write a short, transparent note and two remediation options (credit OR 1x 60min enablement + re-ingest). Plan to send segmented email: high-touch for top 10, bulk for rest.

maria_cs: Uploading affected spreadsheet here: https://redwood.sheets/ops/ingest-blockers — keyed by renewal date & ARR. I'll flag renewal risk = high/medium/low.

ryan_sales: pls add account owners. we need to know who to loop for renewal conversations. For any high risk, i'd prefer CS+AE joint call offer.

sarah_eng: Root cause — regression in duplicate-detection: batching dedupe index not resetting between sub-batches when doc IDs collide. Fix is rolling to staging; deploy to prod in ~45m if tests pass. Mitigation: re-run ingest for impacted batches once prod patch is up.

elena: Good. Tom — please include clear timeline: incident, mitigation ETA, our ask (no action from customer unless they want immediate reingest), and compensation offer. Also include link to a short FAQ and a bridge invite for customers who want live Q&A.

tom: Draft below — will iterate.

elena: For exec summary — 6 lines max: impact, root cause, mitigation, ETA, number of accounts + top 5 names, recommended CS actions. I'll sketch and @maria_cs will fill counts.

elena: @ops_bot bridge created: https://meet.redwood/ops/2190011223 10:30am PT :link:

tom: Customer note template:

```
Hi {{first_name}},

We're reaching out because your ingestion job hit a duplicate-document validation issue which prevented completion. We're actively patching the service and expect a fix in ~45 minutes. No action needed from you to resolve this.

If you'd like an immediate re-ingest or a 1:1 enablement session to accelerate onboarding, reply 'REINGEST' or 'ENABLEMENT' and we'll prioritize you.

We know timing matters — for impacted customers we'll apply a service credit and offer a complimentary onboarding session.

Apologies for the disruption — thanks for your patience.

— Redwood Onboarding Team
```

 tom: Will send to segmented list by 11:15 PT. @ryan_sales — can you confirm a joint-call list for top 8?

ryan_sales: confirming now. i'll DM owners and post list by 10:55.

maria_cs: I've flagged 6 high-risk renewals in the sheet. Adding suggested credit amounts per ARR band.

elena: Great. Postmortem owner: @sarah_eng. CS communications owner: @tom. Sales owner: @ryan_sales. Follow-up checklist:
- send customer note (tom)
- update affected sheet with owner + renewal flag (maria_cs)
- schedule joint calls for high-risk (ryan_sales)
- re-run ingest post-deploy and update each account (sarah_eng)
- log credits and ticket (tom + maria_cs)

Please react with :thumbsup: when you have your item.

tom: :thumbsup: will send.

maria_cs: :thumbsup: adding owners now.

sarah_eng: rolling patch to prod now, ETA 37m. will ping when complete.

ops_bot: Bridge started by elena — https://meet.redwood/ops/2190011223
